title: Tiny, cute bus
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- shadow/ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="32" ry="5" fill="#3a3a6a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- bus body -->
  <rect x="14" y="38" width="72" height="38" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- lighter top highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="38" width="72" height="10" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <!-- roof detail -->
  <rect x="20" y="34" width="60" height="8" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <rect x="20" y="34" width="60" height="4" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#ffb347"/>

  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x="20" y="48" width="14" height="14" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="38" y="48" width="14" height="14" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="56" y="48" width="14" height="14" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <rect x="22" y="50" width="5" height="5" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <rect x="40" y="50" width="5" height="5" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <rect x="58" y="50" width="5" height="5" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="74" y="46" width="10" height="20" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#4a9fd4"/>
  <rect x="76" y="48" width="6" height="8" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>

  <!-- headlights -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="70" r="4" fill="#fff7a0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="70" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x="12" y="72" width="76" height="5" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#e85d3a"/>
  <rect x="12" y="72" width="76" height="2" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#ff7f50"/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="4" fill="#8c8ccc"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="2" fill="#c0c0ee"/>

  <circle cx="70" cy="78" r="8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="78" r="4" fill="#8c8ccc"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="78" r="2" fill="#c0c0ee"/>

  <!-- cute face on front (on the left side bumper area) -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="58" r="2" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="58" r="2" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <path d="M19 63 Q22 66 25 63" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- tiny antenna on top -->
  <line x1="50" y1="34" x2="50" y2="26" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="3" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#fff7a0"/>
</svg>
